arrive.text: The ship of Theseus. Its wood is getting old.

planks.text: New parts are laid out on the dock. Planks, deck boards, a mast and a sail.

first.text: One new plank. Still the same ship, surely.

half.text: More than half of it is new now.

all.text: Not one original part is left. Is it still the same ship?

twist.text: Someone has kept every old part.

rebuilt.text: Two ships. Which one is the ship of Theseus?

new_end.text: You chose the ship that kept sailing. Its parts changed. Its story didn't.

old_end.text: You chose the original wood. Every part is the same. But is the ship?

mast.text: Even the mast. The old one lies on the dock.
